parameters.mapping: popv sub-list entries forwarded to Process_Query/annotate_data: methods -> methods, hvg -> hvg (NULL/False means all shared features), n_samples_per_label -> n_samples_per_label, unknown_celltype_label -> unknown_celltype_label, prediction_mode -> prediction_mode, cl_obo_folder -> cl_obo_folder, query_batch_key/ref_batch_key -> matching kwargs, seed -> python/numpy/torch/scvi seeds, output_dir/quiet/min_shared_genes are wrapper-only

scientific: per-algorithm prediction columns retained in tables$backend_predictions raw payload
wrapper: metadata columns sn_annotation_popv_label and sn_annotation_popv_score (agreement normalized by number of run algorithms)
unified stored result under misc results with schema_version 1.0.0
dropped-cell accounting (cells removed by the upstream min-counts filter receive NA labels)
waivers: PopV UMAP outputs are not imported because Shennong computes its own embeddings

equivalence.ordering: labels joined on cell barcode; candidate cells dropped upstream are excluded from comparison and reported
equivalence.reason: Candidate and oracle invoke identical upstream calls with identical seeds, inputs, and reduced-method list; labels and agreement counts are deterministic given the matched seed.

execution.threads: single-threaded defaults; no BLAS override applied
execution.acceleration: ShennongOpt acceleration disabled (SHENNONG_ACCELERATION_DISABLED=true) for conformance runs
